_provenance: Designer.enumerate_solutions on the 0D disc under delta_e matching, as the
Confinement Designer runs it: m* = 0.322, infinite barrier, COORDS_DISC
(dims = R, L_z), Lmin 1 nm, tol 5%, enum_per_octave 8, enum_polish 40.
The targets are the first six levels of the true 4.0 x 5.0 nm lens, given
to nine spectra with 0.2% gaussian jitter (numpy default_rng(20260918);
spectrum 0 is the noiseless ladder). The two keys are the upper size
bound: '13.0' is the run that converged, '18.0' the one that did not.
Enumeration is deterministic - no RNG anywhere in the search - so these
rows are reproducible from those settings alone. Columns are the Designer
Candidates table's, trimmed to what src/physics/consensus.py reads.
Regenerating costs ~3 minutes; nothing in the test suite does it.
